test_profiler_enable_disable: test the profiler module by enabling and disabling profiling and checking is_enabled state
test_track_context_manager: test the track context manager to profile a code block and verify timing stats are recorded
test_track_time_decorator: test the track_time decorator on a function and verify the decorated function timing is recorded
test_increment_counter_and_record_value: test incrementing counters and recording metric values then verify the stats contain expected counts and values
test_print_report_with_llm_stats: test print_report by simulating LLM call counters and token values then verify the report prints without crashing
